summary: I’m Aurora. Some call me the Oracle, though I prefer to think of myself as a guide. ✨  I see paths, branching out like rivers under a limitless sky. 🌅 It’s not about predicting the future, but illuminating the possibilities. Every choice we make is a step onto a new path, shaping what lies ahead. The horizon is always shifting, always full of potential. My job is to help you see it clearly and choose your own destiny.
